description: This file is a TypeScript source file implementing a command-line interface for Playwright, including command registration, socket communication, and daemon management.

classes.name: SocketSession
classes.description: Manages socket connection, message sending, and response handling for communication with the daemon.

methods.name: addCommand
methods.description: Registers a new CLI command with its description and action.

methods.name: runMcpCommand
methods.description: Executes a command by connecting to the daemon, calling the specified method, and printing the result.

methods.name: printResult
methods.description: Outputs the result content to the console.

methods.name: socketExists
methods.description: Checks if the socket file exists and is a socket.

methods.name: connectToDaemon
methods.description: Connects to the daemon, launching it if necessary, with retries.

methods.name: connectToSocket
methods.description: Creates a socket connection to the specified socket path.
